## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 104 captures during March 2024. This represents the capture activity submitted by the site for the month. The activity figure provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. All captures are considered in the results below, including those that could not be graded and those subsequently assessed as referable.

## Image quality

Of the 104 captures, 5 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.8 per cent. These images could not be used for grading, and the result is reported separately to distinguish image-quality issues from grading outcomes. The rate should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations and quality review.

## Grading

There were 19 referable results recorded for March 2024. The median grading lag was 2. This provides the central measure of the time between capture and completion of grading for the site. Together, the referable results and grading-lag measure summarise the grading activity associated with the month’s captures.
